en: The image shows a section of an ornate interior architectural structure, featuring detailed bas-relief carvings of human figures arranged in scenes, likely telling biblical or historical stories. There are multiple friezes and decorative bands, with columns and what looks like a railing in the foreground. The style and subject suggest Romanesque or early Gothic Christian religious architecture.
